title: Import Gemini output
context: Add an exported file to your library as an external digest.
fileHint: Word (.docx), PDF, Markdown, text, CSV · up to 30 MB
drop: Drop a file here or choose a file.
limit: External digests enter as not reviewed and are not citation evidence. GAID sends nothing to Google.
coversHint: Matched by DOI or title. Choose the papers to link.
noMatches: No library papers match the DOIs or titles in the file.
unmatched: Not in the library · not linked

errors.type: Unsupported file. Choose Word, PDF, Markdown, text or CSV.
errors.size: The file is too large. Split it into files of 30 MB or less and import again.
errors.read: Could not read the file. Check its password and format. For scanned PDFs, import a file with recognized text or a text export.
errors.url: Check the notebook URL. Enter an https URL without sign-in credentials.
errors.expired: Choose the file again. The preview expired or the server restarted.
errors.save: Could not add to the library. Check the folder and connection, then try again.
